m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Did you deal with Doctor Vittek and his crazy Golem creation?
Great work! I doubt we ever see his face down here in Celestia again. Is the Egg alright? May I inspect it?
Whew! The Egg looks perfect! That's a relief. And I think it's almost ready to hatch!
Here you go, Wizard. I'd say you've more than earned this Deep Leviathan pet!
Not only has Doctor Vittek stolen your Deep Leviathan Egg, he's stolen several Worker Golems.
I never should have aided him in finding the Deep Leviathan Egg, but Professor Balestrom asked me to help.
Vittek is insane, Wizard! He plans to create a horrible super soldier War Golem using the Deep Leviathan's essence once it hatches!
You're the only one here with the power to stop this kook. He has a Laboratory in the Science Center. You must act quickly!
If you can retrieve the Egg before it hatches, Vittek won't be able to complete his dastardly War Golem.
Report back to me when you've dealt with him. Good luck!
Retrieve your Deep Leviathan Egg from Doctor Vittek's Laboratory before he's able to complete his dastardly War Golem!
